svg.text: ESP32-C6 takes MIDI in over BLE or USB and relays it to the CH32X035 device engine over I2C. Both retro ports on one board.
board rev 0.1 — in design, layout not routed
Recovery path — the point of this board
CH32 firmware turns SDI off, so a bad flash
used to be unrecoverable. Now the ESP32
owns the CH32's power and BOOT pin: drop
VDD_SW, hold PC17 high, power up — the ISP
ROM keeps SWD alive, so it can reflash.
VDD33 — XIAO LDO out, always on
VCC_JOY (D-SUB pin 5) / VCC_KBD (DIN pin 1) → SS14 Schottky ×2 → VCC_ESP = XIAO 5 V pin
D0 → Q1 gate: cut CH32 power
D1 → 4.7 kΩ → PC17: force the ISP bootloader
I2C 4.7 kΩ, INT 10 kΩ and the
back-feed the CH32 and a power
cycle stops being a real reset.
Every net shown here is declared in the .ato source; this drawing is generated from it by hand, not extracted.
